intent: Record as reviewed the retry, deadline, artifact, origin-key and cancellation rules the run Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context run lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Transient provider refusals start at most the configured number of attempts, after which the run fails as a provider error.
A provider refusal that is neither unavailable nor full is final, so no further attempt starts.
A run no provider has accepted expires once the slot wait limit has passed since its creation, and not before.
Once a provider has accepted an attempt, the run's deadline is its first dispatch plus the frozen policy's hard wall clock, not its creation time.
An artifact the provider reports may name only the archive object the platform derived for the attempt; any other object key is refused.
Each reported artifact must be no larger than the run's frozen per-file limit, and their total within its frozen total limit, before anything is persisted.
A caller's origin key returns the run it already started for the same Skill Version and is refused for a different version.
Every dispatch to a provider carries the platform's own attempt id as its idempotency key, so a re-sent dispatch is deduplicated per attempt and no provider id stands in for the platform's identity.
